memberdef.name: buildODRType

briefdescription.para: Build a DICompositeType with the given ODR identifier.

detaileddescription.para: Looks up the mapped DICompositeType for the given ODR Identifier. If it doesn't exist, creates a new one. If it does exist and isForwardDecl(), and the new arguments would be a definition, mutates the the type in place. In either case, returns the type.
If not LLVMContext::isODRUniquingDebugTypes(), this function returns nullptr.
